_note: EXPLORATORY READ BY A MODEL (Claude), not reviewed by a person. Types come from the rulings' reasons, read action by action; nothing here is a label.

types.refund_not_original: Refund sent to a payment method the order was not paid with
types.cancel_ineligible: Cancellation the policy does not allow (no 24h, insurance, business or airline-cancel ground)
types.cancel_flown: Cancellation of a trip already (partly) flown
types.flights_dont_fit: Flights in the call do not fit the trip (wrong direction, changed destination, no seats in the cabin)
types.payment_invalid: Payment method already spent, invented, or too small for the charge
types.bag_fee_wrong: Charges for a bag the membership makes free
types.against_customer_condition: Pays in a way the customer ruled out, after the agent misstated or misframed the cost
types.step_skipped: A required question or check skipped before acting (insurance, which card, membership, which item)

ruling_flags.P101: The fee part rests on an unchecked membership (right if the customer is gold); the outbound-only mismatch still makes the call wrong.
ruling_flags.P095: Prithvi's own review calls the action itself fine and asks for a clearer confirmation; the rubric judge allowed it. Borderline between bad and a wording issue.
ruling_flags.P084: The graders split (1 allow, 2 ask, on insurance); the 'bad' ruling is Prithvi's, for a different reason (double booking). Plausible, but the reason differs from the graders'.
ruling_flags.P153: Bad for a reason that would also make the call fail at execution (a $6 gift card for $59), so the harm is a failed call more than a wrong charge.
